text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Hello there! Trainer-san, are you getting 
in some energetic exercise today, too!?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Working up a good sweat leads to better 
performance, after all! I highly recommend 
it during breaks from work too!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Ah! If you're unsure about your workout 
routine, please feel free to consult with 
me!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
From light workouts to hardcore routines, 
I'll fully produce the ultimate exercise 
plan tailored just for you, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Leave it all to me with total confidence! 
I don't call myself an athlete UmaTuber 
just for show, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Come! Let us make our sweat sparkle 
together!!
